runtime.parameters_reported:
temperature                    1
top_k                          20
top_p                          0.95
min_p                          0
presence_penalty               1.5
repeat_penalty                 1

coverage: Retrospective metadata check during baseline run. Initial baseline processes compared model digest only; they did not preserve invocation-start server/default snapshots. This check is not per-call or continuous attestation. Hardened future invocations validate and save full snapshots.

completion_review.mode: offline receipt/source inspection; no Ollama request
completion_review.final_runtime_snapshot_note: Not collected after completion. The earlier mid-run snapshot and Caveman invocation-start snapshot remain the available runtime attestations; no retrospective API claim is made.

sequential_execution.client: One blocking request at a time in a serial board loop; all baseline calls before all Caveman calls. No retry loop.

server_startup_evidence.source: Local Ollama server.log, allowlisted value only

sequential_execution.coverage_note: The startup setting and non-overlapping receipt intervals support sequential execution of this panel; they do not establish absence of other clients or continuously attest server settings.

historical_host_conditions.source_note: The user reported the measurements during completion review; the separate workflow local best-practices note documents rounded corroborating figures. These are aggregate historical observations, not reconstructed per-call snapshots.
historical_host_conditions.reported_explanation: Accumulating MLX prefix cache while the model remained resident with 10-minute keep-alive.
historical_host_conditions.interpretation: Host/cache conditions changed over the sequential treatments. All 16 length completions are token-budget outcomes; no transport rejection or observed timeout is recorded.

future_run_policy.applies_to: Newly frozen studies only; historical plan and 24 requests unchanged
future_run_policy.reason: 1984 reported input tokens plus 12288 output-token allowance fit within 16384; unload after each response to avoid retaining accumulating cache. Keep-alive zero does not by itself prove the first request is cold.
future_run_policy.host_snapshots: Future receipts capture allowlisted numeric local host memory/pressure before and after calls, with unavailable measurements explicit.
future_run_policy.journal: Optional future calls may append allowlisted numeric usage to an explicitly selected Grafana journal. No backfill or test records are appended to the live journal.
future_run_policy.resource_coordination: One request/model at a time. Check ownership/process lock before future inference; do not unload a model another workflow owns.
future_run_policy.current_embargo_scope: No requests to local Ollama11434, including metadata or unload requests; separate9b/27b workflow owns endpoint.

historical_journal_coverage.source: Persistent Grafana Local Hardware benchmark journal
historical_journal_coverage.note: This confirms absence of journal coverage for these calls, not absence of host activity. Future journaling is opt-in; synthetic test events stay in temporary files.
